canonicalNote: expectConstructs are canonical saved-document identities that the walker must find. siteCoverage remains generator evidence about which dispatch sites are exercised, which is a different question from what the walker finds in the tree.
fixtureDocumentsCarryNoMetadata: Fixture JSON files contain saved-document content only. Descriptions live here, because an underscore-prefixed commentary key inside the document is an unknown key to the walker and would manufacture an unknown-key gap in every positive fixture.
